51573219.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human Raptor and measured for 200 sec by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR for Kinetic Study: SPR for Kinetic Study. Purified recombinant Raptor protein, which has been diluted in sodium acetate buffer to pH 4.5, was immobilized on the chip (CM5). A series concentration of 1c was flow through the surface of the chip at a flow rate of 30 μL/min for 200 s. The kinetic result was obtained by SPR evaluation software using the 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 6F caption: Binding mode of 1c with the WD40 repeat domain of Raptor. The crystal structure of human Raptor (PDB ID: 5H64) was selected for molecular docking. The hydrogen bond and hydrophobic force were displayed as yellow and blue dashed lines, respectively. The image was generated in PyMOL.
original_paragraph.Figure 6F description: F SPR analysis of interactions between 1c and Raptor in the kinetic level.

immobilization.concentration_for_immobilization: diluted in sodium acetate buffer to pH 4.5
